integrity: All mathematical conclusions follow from the explicit proof; the verification program covers only the stated finite cases. Prior qualitative zero-product-determination results are credited, not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Only split graded commutative Gorenstein algebras with Hilbert vector (1,d,1), d>=2 and nondegenerate symmetric multiplication, and scalar-valued bilinear zero-product preservers. In characteristic two this concerns ordinary zero products, not zero Jordan products. Finite enumeration tests just three prime-field cases. Potential historical overlap in orthogonality-preserver literature remains.
title: Zero-product bilinear forms on socle-degree-two Gorenstein algebras
